kind.description: The check's failure_kind; infra is set by the server for a failed gather constituent, and a timed-out check is failure_class timed_out, never a kind.

file.description: Repository-relative path; a path outside the repository is dropped by the server.

message.description: One line; redacted by the server.

log_line_from.description: First log line of the excerpt that shows the failure.
